themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are aggressively leveraging polling surges and coalition bargaining to force concessions from traditional conservative partners. In Sweden, France, Germany, Spain, and the UK, right-wing leaders are framing their campaigns around national sovereignty and policy red lines as upcoming elections approach.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Jimmie Åkesson asserts party independence ('kosläpp') and demands direct influence over government budgets as coalition talks progress.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella outlines RN's 2027 presidential platform while securing European bank financing for Marine Le Pen's bid.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD expands its polling lead over the Union to seven points and prepares aggressively for potential government power.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal drives campaign momentum ahead of regional elections in Valencia, pressuring the PP to adopt hardline platform commitments.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage fights to halt a polling slump and reclaim parliamentary momentum as the party ties with Tories in key districts.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Law enforcement agencies, electoral courts, and parliamentary bodies across multiple continents are increasing scrutiny on prominent far-right figures and parties. Investigations span foreign campaign funding, human trafficking allegations, financial irregularities, and hate speech convictions.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Federal Police open an investigation into foreign funding of Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign while electoral courts heavily fine Meta for electoral bias.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian law enforcement detains Áron Orbán in a human trafficking probe alongside arrests of figures linked to former government officials.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces potential multi-million euro fines following a data breach that exposed donor identities, while intelligence services maintain surveillance.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: A Reform UK councillor receives a criminal sentence and community service for grossly offensive racist social media posts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: House Republicans narrowly block an impeachment motion against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth amid mounting ethical and operational scrutiny.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and North America are expanding demands for 'national priority' policies in housing, social welfare, and employment. Anti-immigration rhetoric remains the primary axis for mobilizing voters and challenging mainstream policy frameworks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: The central government challenges Vox-backed regional 'prioridad nacional' provisions in court as Abascal escalates anti-Moroccan migration rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Bardella proposes revoking residency permits for foreigners unemployed over six months and denying social housing to individuals with criminal records.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Alice Weidel and AfD leadership double down on remigration proposals to maintain core voter support.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP demands strict, binding integration contracts targeted exclusively at non-Western immigrants.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration faces internal debate and public pressure over the execution of mass deportation promises.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and opposition figures are engaging in cross-border diplomatic engagements and strategic policy alignment outside traditional governmental channels. Discussions focus heavily on European defense spending, regional energy security, and international alliances.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Tisza leader Péter Magyar conducts high-level meetings in Berlin with CDU chief Friedrich Merz on energy transitions, V4 cooperation, and EU budget terms.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian coalition partners Meloni and Salvini clash over international military aid packages for Ukraine and EU regulatory bypasses.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei manages high-stakes international security logistics surrounding the Papal visit while navigating British-Argentine diplomatic disputes over Sea Lion.

themes.title: Transnational Recalibration Following MAGA Midterm Defeats
themes.blurb: Following electoral setbacks in the U.S. midterms, conservative movements in the United States and Latin America are adjusting their political strategies and digital messaging. Realignments include party rebranding, leadership restructuring, and shifts in foreign policy expectations.
